mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:strong labor markets boost consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate increased economic output.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in months with INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $400k, signaling strong retail sales, and HOUST is above 600k, indicating a robust housing market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 60 trading days due to the combined demand boost.
evidence_refs: fact:retail and housing drive economic growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPIAUCSL over two consecutive months, indicating easing inflation pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced interest rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances with declining CPIAUCSL, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the level of UNRATE, as a standalone indicator of labor market health, influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with lower rates indicating stronger returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns do not show a significant negative correlation with UNRATE levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% in a month and FEDFUNDS is below 3%, signaling a favorable supply and monetary environment, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:favorable supply and monetary conditions boost growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
